text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can do it today. I can reach that new level of speed.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I don't need anything. And I won't look back. I will keep my eyes forward and run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka's focus is incredible… Just look at her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, Suzuka! Good lu…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's finally arrived, the Otherworldly Front-Runner, Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Her presence is something else! I can feel it all the way over here. You can tell she's improved beyond her own limits.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I promise. I'll make it this time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I alone will arrive at that world no one has ever seen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Who is that? It feels…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-you're…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Nice to see you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The day has finally arrived. I'm very pleased that we could be here together.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright… Is that really you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You've changed so much since spring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Like you, I've polished myself into something spectacular. I polished our running abilities until they gleamed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I will show each and every one of those abilities to you on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you will. But…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I won't let you catch up to me… You won't. No one will…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (Suzuka is in incredible form today, I can tell. Still…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (I have come prepared with the new ideal of the Mejiros.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (Watch me, Trainer. And my sisters, with your guidance…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (May we bathe this track in the light of the Mejiro family!)
